notes.title: Update v0.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey gardeners!

This update features a new planet for the Krymer solar system, new modules & a couple of fixes!

New
• Desert planet for Krymer system
• A new resource for Krymer system (Prickly lolipop)
• 2 x passive modules (Twister resistance & Turbulence resistance)

Fixes
• Fixed building base occasionally not clipping with ground
• Fixed Eliminator vehicle driving off map in test area

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=imkQIF0Phv0
Thanks for playing Interplanetary Gardener!
- Yellowbound
